significance: A Shakti shrine at Tamluk, the ancient port of Tamralipta, built by the Tamluk Raj family and rebuilt after the medieval Islamic conquest of Bengal. It later served as a gathering point where freedom fighters took their oaths during the independence movement.
story: The left ankle of Sati is said to have fallen here, and the site is linked in local tradition to Bhima of the Mahabharata.
